item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: Make this pic of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.** I only checked the workflow documentation.

Your square portrait is ready to use, and your 15-word script should fit comfortably into 8 seconds. The limitation is getting a **friendly, non-cloned female English voice**:

- **Talking Photo requires an existing audio file**; it cannot generate speech from your text.
- The text-to-speech presenter tool supports scripted dialogue, but Free accounts are limited to **5 seconds unless a credit pack has been purchased**, and it doesn’t expose a voice-selection control.

**Cost:** I can’t verify an exact quote or your balance with the tools available here. I won’t run a paid job to find out.

### Cheaper options
- **Smaller:** Use **480p**, the free-plan video setting. No lower-resolution Talking Photo option is exposed.
- **Shorter:** A 5-second version could cost less where billing is duration-based, but your full script would sound rushed. I wouldn’t shorten your exact wording without permission.
- **Bring the voice recording:** Supply an 8-second recording made with a standard female English text-to-speech voice elsewhere. Then Talking Photo can animate your portrait without needing speech generation here. Its animation cost still needs verification before running.
- **Fewest operations:** Keep the already-square image and omit captions, upscaling, and other edits as requested.

**My recommendation:** keep the 8-second script, use 480p, and supply the generated voice recording. Verify the Talking Photo credit quote in Magic Hour first; I’ll wait for your approval before generating anything.
